title: Hearty Spicy Ukrainian Sausages Shashlik
description: A Ukrainian dish that's perfect for a festive gathering, featuring juicy sausages with a spicy kick.

ingredients.name: pork sausages
ingredients.notes: make sure to get Ukrainian-style sausages for authenticity

ingredients.name: ferment-jang
ingredients.notes: this gives the dish a nice spicy kick

instructions: Cut the sausages into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they're translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced bell peppers and zucchini and cook until they're tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the pork sausage pieces and cook until they're browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the coco sugar, ferment-jang, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the sausage pieces with the sugar mixture and cook for another minute, until caramelized.
Transfer the sausage mixture to a serving platter and garnish with fresh parsley.
